integrity: Source construction, LCD status, parameters and ordinary weight distributions are attributed to Mondal and Lee. The additional coordinatewise recovery spectrum is separated explicitly. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts unordered inclusion-minimal two-helper pairs, not disjoint availability or larger helper sets. The general claim has an analytic proof and examples n=3,4,5 are independently checked. Unindexed equivalent results remain a possible originality risk. The aggregate dual weight-three multiplicity follows from the original ordinary weight enumerator by MacWilliams; its independent novelty is not asserted.
title: Exact two-helper recovery spectrum of augmented ternary affine-half LCD codes
